title: Cancel one inquiry transactionally
requirements: Add only transactional OwnerCommandService.cancel_inquiry for accepted CANCEL: semantic envelope type CANCEL, expected_version, expected_visit_versions, payload {reason}. NEW, NEGOTIATING or CONFIRMED becomes CANCELLED; reason is 1..500. It does not change money facts, terms, notification jobs, Visit.status or other inquiries.

Lock guard, inquiry, its active participation/visit when present, then terms when closing a participation. Require inquiry version. Without active participation expected_visit_versions must be empty; with one current active participation require exactly its current visit version. Missing/malformed maps EXPECTED_VERSION_REQUIRED, stale versions VERSION_CONFLICT, other source status INVALID_TRANSITION. Unknown id NOT_FOUND. Rejected request is atomic and does not consume key.

For active participation close it with close_kind CANCELLED, server closed_at, snapshots {participants_count} and {visit:{id,service_id,start_at,duration_minutes},terms:{service_option_id,participants_count,duration_minutes,total_minor,expected_prepayment_minor,currency,note}}. Increment inquiry and affected visit version only. No active participation is valid cancellation for NEW/NEGOTIATING and changes no visit. Store reason in audit before/after metadata, receipt and event links; return full stable response command_id,inquiry,changed_visits.

Preserve receipt replay/mismatch/expiry semantics using canonical inquiry commands path and typed OwnerCommandError. Add isolated PG tests: cancellation with and without plan, snapshots, group preservation, cash/terms unchanged, all state/version failures/reusable key, replay/mismatch/expiry/audit. No HTTP, group cancellation, payment, migration or external scope.
acceptance: Owner can record cancellation/refusal with history and without changing manual finances or other group clients.
Version and receipt boundaries prevent partial cancellation.
Focused isolated PostgreSQL tests, scope and whitespace pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Accepted narrow cancellation of one inquiry, preserving append-only participation and financial history.
